before.name: Ryuto Tsuda
before.description: Ryuto Tsuda was a Honolulu Buddhist nun, born Kiyome Hirai and also known as Alice Kiyome Tsuda, Ryuto Hirai, Shinsho Hirai and Tatsusho Hirai. JCCH records June 1942 arrest, detention at the US Immigration Station June-July 1942, Sand Island July 1942-March 1943 and Honouliuli March 1943-July 1944. She was paroled in July 1944. After the war she founded and led Todaiji Hawaii Temple until her death in 1987. This was US wartime civilian incarceration; no individual criminal conviction is established by the cited archive. Source: https://incarceration.jcchawaii.org/internees/tsuda-ryuto
